content: Having observed an unideal performance on this task (see Experiments below), we turned our attention to building a model that can replicate the writing style of high popularity listing descriptions. To solve this task, we designed a framework for a general adversarial network. This model employs the standard set up of a generator and a discriminator, but extends the framework with the adoption of the Diehl-Martinez-Kamalu loss.
